text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
One day, when I went to the school store 
with Admire Groove, we spotted Red Desire 
making some mysterious moves.

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
choice_data_list: Wh-What are you doing...?
Wh-What are you doing...?

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
"My. Alv, Trainer. Could you take a look 
at this?"
choice_data_list: な、何をしているんだ……？
な、何をしているの……？

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
"Happy ♪ Blissful Cream Sandwich: Sold out 
due to popular demand—" Ah, could there be 
anything sadder than this?

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
"Next time, I pray that it reaches as many 
students as possible, and fills them with 
happiness—"

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
That is exactly what I was praying for. As 
a Saint...!

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text:
"Yes. ...I think you should move to the 
side a bit."

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
Ah... Pardon me. I got a little carried 
away, didn't I...?
choice_data_list:
(...Come to think of it, aren't those two 
roommates?)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I wondered if they were getting along 
well, but asking felt like meddling where 
I didn't belong. ...However, even after 
that—
choice_data_list: （……そういえば、二人は同室なんだっけ）
choice_data_list_en: (...Come to think of it, those two share a room, don't they?)

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
My goodness! Alve, are you heading out to 
the perimeter track now?

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
In that case, please wait a moment. 
...Allow me to grant you the Saint's 
blessing.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
Twilight is the hour when demons lurk... 
As long as you have my sacred seal, I'm 
sure you'll be safe!

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text: I don't need it.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
"O light of healing— Shine upon the 
wounded...!"
choice_data_list: A lantern... in broad daylight?

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
My... Hehe, have you finally noticed this 
saint's radiant glow?
choice_data_list: 日中に……ランタン？

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
I saw a rather weakened plant, you see. I 
watered it, and wondered if I might heal 
it with holy light as well...

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text:
...I don't think there's much point to 
that.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Even when she sees the two of them, Admire 
Groove's attitude remains coldly 
indifferent.
choice_data_list: (I wonder if my roommate's doing okay…?)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Then, one day, while going over training 
details with Admire Groove――
choice_data_list: （同室、上手くやれてるのかな……？）
choice_data_list_en: (I wonder if they're getting along as roommates...?)

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
Haa, haa...! Alve-san. Do you have a 
moment—

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
Have you seen the "Pitch-Black Fairy Cat" 
anywhere around here!?

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text: I haven't seen it.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
Is that so... No, surely this is another 
trial for a saint. It means I must 
overcome it on my own—!

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
Thank you very much! I shall take my 
leave!
choice_data_list: I wonder why she was in such a rush.

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text:
Well now. Her being in a rush is just par 
for the course.
choice_data_list: あんなに慌てて、どうしたんだろう
choice_data_list_en: I wonder what made them panic like that.

text_block_list.text: —Meow.
choice_data_list: Huh, that cat...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
There was a black cat. Curiously, it 
seemed to be playing with some cloth-like 
object at its feet.
choice_data_list: あれ、あの猫……

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text: ...*sigh*.

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text: —Hold on.

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text:
"...It is Desire-san's handkerchief after 
all. I should leave it on her desk later."
choice_data_list:
Since you're roommates, you could've just 
handed it to her directly.

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text:
As long as it ends up back in our hands, 
it makes no difference.
choice_data_list: 同室なんだから、直接渡せばいいのに
choice_data_list_en: You're roommates, so you could've just given it to her directly.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Afterward, when I asked Red Desire about 
that handkerchief—

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
My! To think you know about the 
purification cloth. ...Just as I thought.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
So Álfr-san was the one who left that for 
us.
choice_data_list: I knew it was all thanks to you, Alv

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
Of course. You've helped me more times 
than I can count, after all.
choice_data_list: アルヴのおかげだって、気づいてたんだ
choice_data_list_en: I knew it was thanks to you, Alv.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
However, it's always very subtle, and she 
never speaks of it directly, though. 
……Fufu.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
However, it is quite all right. After all, 
nothing escapes the eyes of the Saint—

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
That Groove-san's aloofness isn't just 
coldness, by any means.
choice_data_list: ...Yeah, I see.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text: —Oh! The one over there is...!
choice_data_list: ……うん、そっか

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
Groove-san. Thank you from the bottom of 
my heart for picking up my purification 
cloth.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
May the blessings of the Saint be upon 
you—

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text: I don't need it.

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text: …………Trainer. Why are you laughing?
choice_data_list:
I'm relieved to see you're getting along 
well.

You and your roommate really help each 
other out, huh?

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text:
"...Doing this much is normal. We're 
roommates, after all."
choice_data_list: 上手く付き合えてるみたいで安心した
ルームメイトと助け合ってるんだね
choice_data_list_en: I'm relieved to see you're getting along well.
You two really help each other out, huh.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
Fufu... I'm glad to hear you say that. I 
truly believe it was fate that made us 
roommates, after all.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
"I look forward to continuing to work with 
you, Alv-san."

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text:
...It's just that Desire-san has a bit of 
a tendency to run into misfortune.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
Fufu. After all, I am a Saint. I welcome 
any and all trials with open arms.

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text: ...I see.
